lede: The single meeting worth clearing your calendar for this week is the Telluride Town Council's three-hour budget work session on Tuesday, October 13 — enterprise funds, open space, and affordable housing are all on the table, and the numbers worked through here drive formal adoption later. Ouray County commissioners also have a full day Tuesday, including a vote on opting into Proposition 123's affordable housing commitment cycle and a Special Use Permit amendment in Colona. Mountain Village Council takes up second reading of an ordinance changing how MVHA housing fees are set on Thursday, which is as consequential as it sounds for anyone tied to workforce housing there.
